aside_title: Additional touches to make your wedding day even more special
lead: If you're reading this, that special moment has probably already arrived, and you're beginning to imagine the day when you'll exchange your vows.
body:
Rest assured that whether you're planning an Orthodox ceremony in Greece, a legal marriage registration or another bridal or romantic event, our wedding offerings already include everything needed for smooth organization, from documentation and venue permissions to decoration and coordination of the day itself.

Still, there is always room to make a special day even better, and a wedding in Greece is no exception. For couples who want to make the experience even more memorable, add a touch of luxury and ensure the highest level of comfort for themselves and their guests, we offer a range of additional services.

These include premium transport for the couple and guests, accommodation at some of the finest hotels and villas each Greek destination has to offer, professional photographers and videographers trusted through years of cooperation, private tours by land or sea tailored around your interests, wedding banquets ranging from intimate dinners to large receptions, and dedicated concierge assistance throughout your stay.

Each service can be added according to your plans, preferences and destination. Need something different? Share your wishes through our request form, and we'll explore every possibility to make it happen.
